# vantage_dashboard_notifications (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vantage_dashboard_notifications" "all" {}

output "all_dashboard_notifications" {
  value = data.vantage_dashboard_notifications.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `dashboard_notifications` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboard_notifications))

<a id="nestedatt--dashboard_notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboard_notifications`

Read-Only:

- `dashboard_token` (String) The token for the Dashboard the DashboardNotification sends.
- `frequency` (String) The frequency the DashboardNotification is sent.
- `id` (String) The id of the resource
- `recipient_emails` (List of String) The email addresses that receive the notification, including organization users, SSO-domain addresses, and approved third-party addresses.
- `title` (String) The title of the DashboardNotification.
- `token` (String)
- `user_tokens` (List of String) The tokens of organization users that receive the notification. Freeform SSO-domain and approved third-party emails are not included; see recipient_emails.
